tables.name: Recent History
tables.description: Village gossip: events of the past few weeks or months, up to a year at most.

results.name: Animal Issues
results.description: Livestock, or pets, may have been ravaged by local wildlife, or monsters, or animals may have been struck by sickness or pestilence.

results.name: Attacks
results.description: Members of the community have been attacked, either by brigands or, perhaps, monsters.

results.name: Bumper Production
results.description: A staple resource of the village has yielded very well, recently.

results.name: Out of Favor
results.description: The village has been subject to the ire of a nearby ruler, or entity.

results.name: Entertainment
results.description: A certain form of entertainment is proving popular, whether a game or pastime, the arrival of a storyteller or musician, or something else.

results.name: Fear
results.description: Something unnerving, or frightening, has happened recently.

results.name: Good Fortune
results.description: The village has received favorable notice from a nearby ruler, or entity of note.

results.name: Infestation
results.description: Some form of vermin, or pest, has recently beset the village, and has become an ongoing issue.

results.name: Poor Production
results.description: A staple resource of the village has yielded poorly of late.

results.name: Power Vacuum
results.description: The death, or absence, of a local leadership figure, or figures, has led to internal strife within the community.

results.name: Safe Haven
results.description: The village has become a sanctuary for refugees, or those in need.

results.name: Wartorn
results.description: The village was occupied by military forces, and suffered damages, during wartime in the recent past.
